events.title: Crown Tactics is in Steam Next Fest! (+ Daily Runs & Under the Hood)
events.summary: It’s October, and I’m so excited to finally say it: Crown Tactics is officially in Steam Next Fest!If you're discovering Crown Tactics for the first time during the festival, welcome! Grab the demo, hit the board, and see how high you can climb before the timer catches up to you. And to everyone who’s been following along since the demo dropped in August, thank you so much for the support!
